items.text: OTHER IMPORTANT ADDITION REACTIONS OF ALKENES

items.label: text
items.text: The addition of water to propene could produce two different products, propan-1-ol and propan-2-ol. In reality, much more propan-2-ol is formed than propan-1-ol. In the major reaction, a hydrogen atom from water is first added onto the end carbon and then the -OH group is attached to the middle carbon. The addition of compounds to an unsymmetrical alkene like propene will be explored in detail when you study chemistry at a more advanced level.
